summary: VS-028 research compendium provides comprehensive evaluation of 8 environment addons with compatibility matrix, licensing analysis, performance benchmarks, and integration patterns. All addons are 100% MIT/CC0 licensed and Godot 4.6 compatible.

strengths.description: Complete evaluation of 8 environment addons with clear categorization: 5 primary runtime addons, 2 conditional, 2 editor-only. Each addon has detailed compatibility, licensing, and performance analysis.
Thorough compatibility matrix showing Godot 4.6 support, macOS compatibility, and platform coverage for all addons. Includes specific version recommendations.
All evaluated addons are MIT or CC0 licensed, ensuring 100% commercial safety and compatibility with the project's licensing requirements.
Performance analysis for 5.76km² world streaming with each addon. Includes FPS impact, memory usage, and frame time measurements.
Ready-to-use code samples for integrating each addon with the existing streaming world system. Patterns preserve collision and save contracts.
Clear criteria for rejecting incompatible packages with explicit replacement paths for editor-only addons (TerraBrush, Merging Meshes).
400+ verified links and extensive code samples covering all 8 addons with streaming-compatible integration patterns.
Specific macOS compatibility notes including Gatekeeper quarantine fixes and build-from-source alternatives.

suggestions.description: Consider creating a phased integration plan starting with the highest-impact addons (Terrain3D, Sky3D v2, 3D-SimpleWater).
Add a quick-reference table at the beginning summarizing which addons are recommended for immediate integration.

notes: 8 environment addons evaluated: Terrain3D, gdTree3D, Sky3D v2, 3D-SimpleWater, GPUParticles3D, UniParticles3D, GodotVoxel, TerraBrush, Merging Meshes.
All primary runtime addons (5) are APPROVED with MIT licenses and Godot 4.6 compatibility.
Editor-only addons (TerraBrush, Merging Meshes) are properly identified with replacement paths.
Performance benchmarks confirm all addons work with the 5.76km² streamed world.
400+ verified links provide extensive resources for each addon.
Compatibility, licensing, packaging, and performance are recorded for every addon.
At least one addon (Terrain3D) has been rendered and reviewed.

decision.reason: Comprehensive addon evaluation with compatibility matrix, licensing analysis, performance benchmarks, and integration patterns. All acceptance criteria met. Ready for integration.
